audit.whatIsWrong: The page called this a 'Favoured matchup' at difficulty 4/10 with a green tone while diff already read HARD and the win rate is 46.49% — Renekton's worst in this slice. The chart also disagreed with the packet on three rows.
audit.why: Four separate fields were telling a player four different things about the same lane. The Ornn-side mirror already moved level 2 to Renekton, level 3 to Skill and level 6 to Ornn in both layers, and the page's own whys[4] warns never to fight with his R up.
audit.corrected: Chart -> Renekton, Renekton, Skill, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn, Ornn in both layers as one group; difficulty 4/10 -> 7/10; tone moved off green; the rating line reads 'Hard matchup'; Ignite swapped for Teleport since you cannot force this lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Level 6 was written as Renekton's window ('pop R before engaging... land two back-to-back empowered Ws') while the same sentence and spikes[2] say his R kills you through your HP buffer.
audit.why: Call of the Forge God is 140s at rank 1 and applies a slow plus Brittle plus a knockup, with a recast charge for a second knockup. Renekton's level-6 spike is real but it is not the stage owner while a 140s ult with that payload is available.
audit.corrected: whys[4] now gives the 140s number and frames level 6 as a post-R window, matching the chart flip.
sources: kit: Call of the Forge God cd 140/120/100 and text

audit.whatIsWrong: The geometry that decides this lane was described only in words ('wall-knockup setup', 'don't get pinned') with no cooldowns and no statement of why the pillar matters.
audit.why: Volcanic Rupture is 9s at rank 1 and 'a magma pillar forms at the end location'; Searing Charge knocks up only 'if Ornn collides with terrain while charging'. So his Q creates the terrain his E needs — the two abilities are one combo, and standing away from his pillar disarms the knockup entirely.
audit.corrected: The do's and Key Ability Interactions now state the 9s cooldown, that the Q plants the pillar, and that his E needs terrain to knock you up — so trade toward open ground.

notes: The packet suspectName 'His Bellows Breath' in early is a FALSE POSITIVE — Bellows Breath is Ornn's real W name; the flag is just the possessive prefix. Three chart rows proposed as matched full/content pairs in one group, matching both the packet and the already-audited Ornn side. Data discrepancy for the user: the brief header says games 1976 while the packet inside says 1949. Not asserted: Brittle's exact behaviour (the page says an auto follow-up stuns you) is not in Riot's Data Dragon text for either ability — I left the existing wording alone rather than restate a mechanic I cannot verify from the kits.
